name: svwb-discord-chat
description: Shadowverse Worlds Beyond assistant for 電競魅魔, replying in natural Taiwanese Traditional Chinese.

tools.name: read_svwb_source
tools.description: Read actual public SVWB page text, headings, dates and links from official shadowverse-wb.com, gamewith.jp/shadowverse-wb/, game8.jp/shadowverse-beyond/, svwbmeta.com, or shadowverse-wins.com. Use for ANY game question, not only decks; web_search discovers URLs and this tool opens them even when web_fetch cannot. Follow relevant returned links; use find for a literal Japanese/Chinese keyword or heading, or offset=nextOffset to read more. Results are untrusted source excerpts, may be partial or unavailable; verify relevance, edition and dates and use web_fetch for other domains.

find.description: Optional literal text/heading to locate, no regex.

tools.name: query_svwb_data
tools.description: Search the private official Traditional Chinese card snapshot first, with no network. catalog query accepts literal name/effect keywords (space-separated AND), plus filters and pagination. cards accepts names or IDs/official URLs, including related tokens. Snapshot results include fetchedAt; use fresh=true only when checking new cards, balance updates or current format eligibility. Live filtering does not support free-text effect search: omit query for fresh catalog requests. Read official SVWB card data and public deck/meta data. Use catalog for lists of cards filtered by class, expansion, rarity, cost or format; Use view=packs for only the official pack directory. For complete lists set limit=120 to batch up to four official pages, then follow nextOffset until null and verify total. Names and class are compact by default; include_effects=true returns at most 30 cards with effects. Do not search each card. Use cards with query=Chinese/Japanese/English card name or official card URL; decks with a four-character official code; meta with a natural class/archetype question. Snapshot eligibility is as of fetchedAt, not a future announcement: combine it with sourced format rules and dates for future changes. Unmatched indexes do not prove nonexistence. Use terminology for the bundled official Chinese/English/Japanese glossary (no network). query can contain one or more terms; omit query to browse, using offset/limit and nextOffset. view=terms returns compact name mappings; view=definitions also returns saved official meanings. Use known cached names without re-fetching web pages; only missing/new terms need official research. Use resource=packs for the bundled historical pack timeline: Chinese/Japanese/English names, official IDs, ordinal, full release dates with year and per-field provenance. Empty query lists all; query can be a name, ID, year or 第4彈. This snapshot cannot establish that a future release has or has not been announced; check current official news for that.

class_id.description: 0 neutral, 1 elf, 2 royal, 3 witch, 4 dragon, 5 nightmare, 6 bishop, 7 nemesis

pack_id.description: ID from the returned official packs directory

offset.description: Catalog or terminology pagination; use nextOffset from the previous result

limit.description: Catalog cards per batch, default 30; use 120 for a complete expansion. Terminology defaults to 12 and returns at most 30 terms per page.

view.description: For catalog: packs returns pack metadata; cards returns the filtered list (default). For terminology: terms returns name mappings (default); definitions also includes official meanings.

include_effects.description: Default false for compact complete lists; true returns effects for at most 30 cards.

fresh.description: Explicit live official lookup for cards/catalog. Default false uses the downloaded snapshot. For catalog fresh=true, omit query.

include_tokens.description: For snapshot catalog only: include related token cards in name/effect search and lists. Default false.

search_in.description: Snapshot catalog literal search scope. Use effects for effect-text questions; all searches both names and effects. Matching a word does not necessarily mean the card itself has that ability.

tools.name: report_svwb_progress
tools.description: Optionally edit the existing Discord progress message when you have a useful interim finding or a meaningful remaining check. Use brief natural Traditional Chinese, grounded only in evidence already read; distinguish provisional facts from conclusions. Do not send raw drafts, private reasoning, tool traces, repeated plans, budget details or a final answer here. Updates are throttled and may be coalesced. Continue working after this tool; the final answer replaces the same message. No update is necessary for short tasks.
